tw: Kron trudges through a river of fudge, but the fudge won't budge a smudge.
twc: Kron 在一条软糖河里艰难跋涉，软糖纹丝不动。

tw: Kron turns his trike onto the turnpike and pays the toll with a pike.
twc: Kron 骑三轮车拐上收费高速，用一条梭子鱼付了过路费。
hint: 收费站只收钱，他交了条鱼。

tw: Tiny tyrant Kron rants at ants, and the ants rant right back.
twc: 小暴君 Kron 冲蚂蚁大吼，蚂蚁也冲他吼回去。

tw: Ultimately, Kron gives Tom the cat an ultimatum: off my mat, or no tuna.
twc: Kron 给猫汤姆下最后通牒：下我的垫子，不然没金枪鱼。

tw: Kron lets go of the tug-of-war unilaterally, and later the llamas fall.
twc: Kron 单方面松开拔河绳，随后羊驼们全摔倒了。
hint: 他一个人说了算，对面全倒。

tw: Under the moon at an untimely time, Kron's alarm chimes nine times.
twc: 月亮下的不合时宜时刻，Kron 的闹钟响了九下。

tw: An upsurge of bubbles: Kron shakes the soda, and up it surges.
twc: 气泡猛涨：Kron 一摇汽水，汽水冲天而起。

tw: Kron usurps the syrup throne and slurps syrup from the crown.
twc: Kron 篡夺了糖浆王座，用王冠喝糖浆。
hint: 抢了王位，先喝王冠里的。

tw: The seaside vacation inn has one vacancy: a vacant can, so Kron climbs in.
twc: 海边度假旅馆只剩一个空位：一个空罐头，Kron 只好钻进去。

tw: Kron vanquishes the van of squishy squid with one quick swish.
twc: Kron 一挥就征服了一车软乎乎的鱿鱼。
hint: 一甩面条剑，鱿鱼全投降。

tw: Kron's reindeer veer near the pier, and Kron steers with his ears.
twc: Kron 的驯鹿在码头边急转弯，Kron 用耳朵掌舵。
hint: 驯鹿一转向，他照样淡定。

tw: Genius Kron sees Venus, but it's Vee the goose's shiny knees.
twc: 天才 Kron 以为看到了金星，其实是鹅小维闪亮的膝盖。
hint: 金星没找到，先找到鹅膝盖。

tw: Kron serves a veritable feast: every vegetable on a very tall table.
twc: Kron 端上一场真正的盛宴：一张超高桌子上摆满所有蔬菜。
hint: 真正的盛宴，高到要爬梯子。

tw: Kron's parrot speaks the local vernacular and knocks Kron's spectacular jar of nuts.
twc: Kron 的鹦鹉满嘴本地话，还敲他那罐漂亮的坚果。

tw: Kron enjoys a vicarious car ride: he watches Vicky the cat drive, curious.
twc: Kron 过了把替代的开车瘾：好奇地看猫咪维琪开车。
hint: 自己不开，看别人开也爽。

tw: Vile Kron smiles a vile smile and steals the crocodile's pile of tiles.
twc: 卑鄙的 Kron 坏坏一笑，偷走了鳄鱼的一摞瓷砖。

tw: Vince stole his ball, so vindictive Kron dips Vince's dictionary in vinegar.
twc: 文斯偷了他的球，记仇的 Kron 把文斯的词典泡进醋里。

tw: Kron's virulent green lentil brew makes the vines wilt and rulers melt.
twc: Kron 那锅剧毒绿扁豆汤让藤蔓枯萎，尺子融化。

tw: Kron's voluminous volume of loony moon news buries him up to his nose.
twc: Kron 那本超厚的月亮怪新闻合集把他埋到鼻子。

tw: Kron makes a vow to the cow: from now on, I'll bow, wow!
twc: Kron 对奶牛发誓：从现在起我要鞠躬，哇！
